items.title: Michael Palin's Pole to Pole Vol. 2
items.description: The second volume of Michael Palin's 1992 travel documentary series, in which he journeys from the North Pole to the South Pole. The series follows Palin's overland and sea route through Europe, Africa, and beyond.

items.title: Michael Palin's Pole to Pole Vol. 3
items.description: Volume 3 of Michael Palin's 1992 BBC travel series in which Palin journeys from the North Pole to the South Pole along the 30-degree-east line of longitude. This installment covers segments of the expedition through Africa and beyond.
